text: The sect holds its yearly tournament. Disciples line up to test their skill before the elders.

outcomes.text: You fight your way to the final and take the crown!
You win a few rounds before falling to a stronger disciple.
You are knocked out in the first round, to general laughter.

choices.label: Watch and learn from the best

outcomes.text: You study the winning techniques closely.

text: A senior elder summons you for a private audience and asks what you have learned.

outcomes.text: The elder smiles and shares a piece of hard-won advice.
The elder is amused by your confidence and rewards it.
The elder is not amused. You are sent to copy scriptures for a month.

text: War! A rival sect declares open conflict, and every disciple of fighting age is called to the front.

outcomes.text: You earn a name on the battlefield and the sect's gratitude.
The line breaks and you barely escape alive.

choices.label: Serve in the rear as a healer and supplier

outcomes.text: Unglamorous work, but many live because of you.

choices.label: Slip away while the sect is distracted

outcomes.text: You vanish into the night. The sect will not forgive a deserter.

text: Years of wandering have made your name known. A sect elder arrives at your door with an offer of a place among them.

choices.label: Accept a place in the Azure Cloud Sect
Accept a place in the Blood Moon Sect

outcomes.text: The Blood Moon Sect welcomes a strong recruit.

choices.label: Accept a place in the Verdant Pill Pavilion

outcomes.text: The pavilion values a cultivator with real-world experience.
The elder bows and leaves. Your independence is respected.
